diagnosis.plain_language: Acute pharyngitis is a recent-onset inflammation of the throat, commonly known as a sore throat.

medications.name: Amoxicillin
medications.purpose_plain: Amoxicillin is an antibiotic used to treat infections caused by bacteria.

medications.name: Paracetamol
medications.purpose_plain: Paracetamol is a medicine generally used to relieve pain and reduce fever.

advice_verbatim: Warm saline gargles. Rest and plenty of fluids.
follow_up: Review after 5 days if not improving.
